en.tashayyu: 50 – Aḥmad b. Isḥāq b. ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿd b. Mālik  b. al-Aḥwaṣ, al-Ashʿarī, Abū ʿAlī, al-Qummī.

I have seen books from him: the book of the reasons for the fast, a large (book), the questions of have seen books from him: the book of the reasons for the fast, a large (book), the questions of the men (masa’il al-Rijāl) to Abū al-Ḥasan the Third  عليه السلام that he compiled.
